types.name: STRAY
types.text: The common one. It has no interest in you, only in sound. It walks to wherever the last noise was, and if you are not there when it arrives it casts about and then wanders off. Two hits to put down.

types.name: HUNTER
types.text: Bigger, and it hears most of the ship. Inside two compartments it has you regardless of how quiet you are, and it will not lose you until you are further off than that. Hits twice as hard as a STRAY and takes three to put down.

types.name: CRAWLER
types.text: Lives in the ducts, so a dropped bulkhead means nothing to it and it covers two compartments an hour. Flooding the vents from the bridge kills every one of them at once. In the REACTOR it chews the output instead of you.

types.name: MOTHER
types.text: It hears the whole ship, it never loses the thread, and NOTHING ABOARD CAN KILL IT. Weapons do not mark it. What you can do is cost it time: a bulkhead in its face holds it an hour while it takes the door apart, flooding the vents holds it two, and anything loud thrown somewhere else will turn it around. It wakes when the hold has had enough of you.
